Method: Primary documentation and public interface review; no competitor binary execution

Products.Finding: Recovery credentials need a separate handling policy.
Products.Acceptance: Test recovery on a copy. Verify every exported file before reporting success.

Products.Finding: Cleaner rules separate selection and action. Rules alone cannot authorize deletion.
Products.Acceptance: Compare preview inventory with a synthetic tree. Keep production cleanup disabled.

Products.Finding: Free-space cleaning has limits, including filename remnants.
Products.Acceptance: Label the selected scope and medium. Never infer physical SSD erasure from file disappearance.

Products.Finding: Header restoration addresses volume access; file integrity needs separate evidence.
Products.Acceptance: Reopen a fixture copy and verify authenticated extraction after recovery.

Products.Finding: The public module interface separates settings from enable and disable operations.
Products.Acceptance: Test repeated start, cancel and dispose. Verify that the module releases resources.
